exposure: obesity class (class I, class II, class III)
cohort: 2466 singleton births from mothers with obesity from 2013-2017 in Northern Sydney Local Health District
finding: The study found that higher obesity class in pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including LGA, independent of maternal factors such as GDM.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in women with higher obesity classes.
